questions.q: To which Misl did Maharaja Ranjit Singh belong?
questions.qPa: ਮਹਾਰਾਜਾ ਰਣਜੀਤ ਸਿੰਘ ਕਿਸ ਮਿਸਲ ਨਾਲ ਸੰਬੰਧ ਰੱਖਦੇ ਸਨ?
questions.explanation: Maharaja Ranjit Singh belonged to the Sukerchakia Misl, founded by his grandfather Charat Singh.

questions.q: In which year did Ranjit Singh capture Lahore from the Bhangi Sardars?
questions.explanation: Ranjit Singh captured Lahore in 1799, a turning point that led to the establishment of the Sikh Empire.

questions.q: According to the Treaty of Amritsar (1809), which river was fixed as the boundary between the Sikh Empire and British India?
questions.qPa: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਸਰ ਦੀ ਸੰਧੀ (1809) ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਸਿੱਖ ਸਾਮਰਾਜ ਅਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਟਿਸ਼ ਭਾਰਤ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਨਦੀ ਨੂੰ ਹੱਦ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸੀ?
questions.explanation: The River Sutlej was established as the boundary by the Treaty of Amritsar in 1809.

questions.q: Who was the famous Sikh general who died defending the fort of Jamrud in 1837?
questions.explanation: Hari Singh Nalwa, the legendary commander of the Sikh Khalsa Army, died at the Battle of Jamrud in 1837.

questions.q: Who among the following European officers was primarily responsible for training Maharaja Ranjit Singh's cavalry?
questions.explanation: Jean-François Allard, a former officer in Napoleon's army, was hired to train the Sikh cavalry.

questions.q: In which year was Kashmir annexed to the Sikh Empire?
questions.qPa: ਕਸ਼ਮੀਰ ਨੂੰ ਸਿੱਖ ਸਾਮਰਾਜ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ ਸਾਲ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਸੀ?
questions.explanation: Kashmir was conquered and annexed by the Sikh Empire in 1819.

questions.q: Who served as the Foreign Minister in Maharaja Ranjit Singh's secular administration?
questions.explanation: Fakir Azizuddin served as the trusted Foreign Minister for Maharaja Ranjit Singh.

questions.q: What was the special, European-trained elite core of the Sikh army called?
questions.explanation: The Fauj-i-Khas was the modernized, regular army trained by European generals.
